response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS tally FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), s AS (SELECT archstat, tally, tally * 1.0 / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM t), a AS (SELECT archstat, tally, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT archstat, tally, share, share - avg_share AS share_above_average FROM a WHERE share > avg_share
